content.short: Certora provides formal verification tools and smart contract audits for Web3 security.
content.description: Certora Prover is a SaaS security tool that automatically identifies rare, hard-to-find smart contract bugs and provides mathematical proofs of their absence. It is well suited for audits and bug bounty programs, and it can be integrated into deployment pipelines to assist developers and security researchers. Formal verification helps smart contracts manage their modular structure and reduce the risk and cost of errors. In addition to the prover, Certora offers auditing, incident response, and other security services.
